g.text: idea-bot - a new idea, then a reply in its thread (2026-11-27)
"cloud lamp that shows the forecast + link"
wait for lock (one run at a time)
spawn; NEW_IDEA_PROMPT + your text on stdin
(may run its own claude -p to fix)
"it's for the bedroom, make it P2"
